# 原版职位始终处理；变身大明 / 东方王朝职位仅在 skonester_compat_*_loaded 为真时调用（见 skonester_compat_triggers.txt）。

skonester_positions_revoke_one_court_slot_fully_effect = {
  scope:skonester_pos_reshuffle_liege = {
    while = {
      limit = { employs_court_position = $COURT_POS$ }
      random_court_position_holder = {
        type = $COURT_POS$
        save_scope_as = skonester_pos_revoke_holder
      }
      if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:skonester_pos_revoke_holder }
        revoke_court_position = {
          recipient = scope:skonester_pos_revoke_holder
          court_position = $COURT_POS$
        }
        clear_saved_scope = skonester_pos_revoke_holder
      }
    }
  }
}

skonester_positions_upgrade_all_named_court_positions_if_better_effect = {
  scope:skonester_pos_reshuffle_liege = {
    skonester_positions_upgrade_core_named_court_positions_if_better_effect = yes
    if = {
      limit = { skonester_compat_daming_loaded_trigger = yes }
      skonester_positions_upgrade_daming_named_court_positions_if_better_effect = yes
    }
    if = {
      limit = { skonester_compat_orient_loaded_trigger = yes }
      skonester_positions_upgrade_orient_named_court_positions_if_better_effect = yes
    }
  }
}
